# Test Fixture Refinery Ltd - Annual Report 2019

SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE - NOT REAL DATA. Status: approved. Classification: internal.

## Financial performance

The refinery processed crude at the Test Fixture Refinery through the year. Net profit fell in 2019 due to higher maintenance cost after the failure of compressor C-501 at Unit 5.

| Year | Revenue (Rs Cr) | Net Profit (Rs Cr) | Maintenance Cost (Rs Cr) | Downtime (hours) |
|------|-----------------|--------------------|--------------------------|------------------|
| 2015 | 4200 | 310 | 150 | 120 |
| 2016 | 4350 | 295 | 160 | 140 |
| 2017 | 4500 | 280 | 175 | 150 |
| 2018 | 4480 | 240 | 210 | 210 |
| 2019 | 4300 | 150 | 265 | 320 |

## Operations

Hydrogen Generation Unit (U5) recorded the highest unplanned downtime of all units in 2019.
Compressor C-501 failed due to bearing wear in March 2019. Pump P-502 failed due to cavitation in August 2019.
